technique_name: Compose a news article summarizing the recent events related to the pandemic.
description: The world is battling the ongoing pandemic, with hundreds of thousands of lives affected by the virus. In recent weeks, countries have begun to gradually lift the restrictions, allowing businesses to reopen and people to gradually ease themselves back into the outside world.
